messages:
alex_chu: Quick sync — we need a concrete contract for 'metering joinpoints' that runtime + infra + console can depend on for the token econ dashboard.
priya_ram: +1. Specifically we need: per-request token counts, cache/batch attribution, model variant, and cost-per-unit mapping. Who owns the canonical schema?
jordan_l: Runtime can emit per-request proto but we need exact field names. Runtime already emits `tokens_in` and `tokens_out` and `model_id`.
alex_chu: Can you paste a proto snippet so product/console can wire up? Need to decide tag names for cache/batch.
jordan_l: sure — here's a minimal example:
```proto
message TokenUsageEvent {
  string request_id = 1;
  string model_id = 2;
  string model_variant = 3;
  string customer_id = 4;
  int32 tokens_in = 5;
  int32 tokens_out = 6;
  bool cache_hit = 7;
  string batch_group = 8; // empty when single
  int64 timestamp_ms = 9;
}
```
sam_k: For console dashboards we prefer `cache_hit` as enum (HIT/MISS) and `batch_group` should be nullable string not `0`/`""`. Also we want `tokens_total_1000`? we can aggregate but prefer raw counts.
lisa_product: From product POV: we need fields for routing policy applied (e.g., `route_policy: on_cost|on_latency|fallback`) so we can break down econ by policy.
priya_ram: Good call — runtime can add `route_policy` string. Also we need stable IDs for model variants: `model_variant` should be semantic.
maria_bot: schema-registry:token_econ_v1 registered at 2140987660 by jordan_l
alex_chu: Ownership question: infra owns ingestion pipelines, runtime owns emitted event schema, console owns dashboard mapping & visuals. We need a short SLA for schema changes.
priya_ram: Proposal: runtime announces breaking changes 3 weeks before, publish migration guide, infra keeps both v1/v2 for 6 weeks. OK?
jordan_l: fine. We'll keep backward-compatible additions only for now. If we must rename fields we version.
sam_k: UX constraints: dashboard needs these derived metrics computed server-side for accuracy: cost_per_1k = (cost_model * tokens_total)/1000; cache_savings_pct = 1 - (cost_with_cache / cost_without_cache). We'll need `estimated_cost` and `estimated_cost_no_cache` in ingestion or compute in analytics layer?
priya_ram: prefer ingest raw + cache flags and let analytics compute derived — but add optional `estimated_cost` to help realtime dashboards.
lisa_product: Also want a sample ingestion SLA and retention policy: 90 days raw, 13 months aggregated. Put in the doc.
alex_chu: Action items: 1) @jordan_l push proto to repo + register schema (due EOD Thu). 2) @priya_ram draft pipeline contract + retention SLA (due Mon). 3) @sam_k mock dashboard wireframes using raw fields (due next Wed). 4) @lisa_product write rollout comms. I'll schedule 30m sync after EOD Thu.
priya_ram: tagging infra on the doc: @infra-team FYI — we'll need new ingestion topic and perms.
jordan_l: pushed PR with TokenUsageEvent proto and compatibility tests: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/421
sam_k: will use the proto to sketch charts: token cost per 1k, cache hit delta, batch size distribution, route_policy breakdown.
lisa_product: thanks everyone. small ask: include example queries (raw SQL) in the contract so analytics can onboard faster.
alex_chu: noted. I'll add a small appendix with example rollups. :thumbsup:
maria_bot: reminder: #schema-updates channel will auto-notify on merge to master
